newsitem.title: USA: Saudi finance minister sees 6 pct growth in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Saudi finance minister sees 6 pct growth in 1996.

text.p: Saudi Arabia expects economic growth to excedd 6 percent in 1996 and is also "optimistic" about growth in 1997, Saudi finance minister Ibrahim Al-Assaf said on Thursday.
"For '97, clearly things depend on developments in the oil market, but we are also optimistic," he said to reporters after speaking at the U.S.-Saudi Business Council meeting.
He added that Saudi Arabia is "committed" to measures that will lead to a balanced budget but he would not make any projections as to when that might occur.
